text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-89234 — p99 latency (eu-west) crossed 2.0s threshold for inference-runtime-primary. Current burn: 48% of p99 SLO in last 10m. Links: https://pagerduty.example/PD-89234 · runbook: https://confluence.example/incidents/inference-p99

pagerduty-bot: Paging riley-oncall (primary) and on-call rotation. Incident assigned to riley-oncall.

riley-oncall: ack — I’m on it. pulling metrics now.

jasmin-sre: seeing the spike too, requests with token counts ~120 are spiking. Could be KV-cache thrash + large-batch slowdown.

noah-platform: autoscaler shows rapid scale-up attempts in eu-west, but some pods stuck in ContainerCreating for ~90s. kube-events: "FailedMount" on sidecar volume in two pods.

riley-oncall: copying logs —
```
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep eu-west
inference-runtime-0   1/2 CrashLoopBackOff  0          3m
inference-runtime-1   2/2 Running          123m
inference-sidecar-0   0/1 Init:CrashLoop   1          2m
```

riley-oncall: hmm sidecar init failing on configmap mount, likely causing single-az capacity drop. scaling is trying to fill but failing.

deploy-bot: Recent deploy: inference-runtime v3.4.1 rolled out 12m ago across eu-* (commit 9f2c3a). No rollback yet.

jasmin-sre: can we try redirecting traffic to fallback variant (v3.3.x quantized) in eu-west while we investigate? That should drop p99 by ~30-40ms and reduce memory pressure.

riley-oncall: running the traffic split runbook: `rbac split-route --service inference-runtime --region eu-west --weight 30 --variant v3.3.x`

noah-platform: executed. Confirmed route change in the gateway: 30% -> v3.3.x.

emma-product: FYI product teams are seeing elevated user complaints in EU (slow responses). Ticket count +2 in last 15m.

jasmin-sre: also toggled adaptive-batching to conservative for the affected nodes to avoid large long-running batches. command:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://ops-api/realtime/config -d '{"batching":"conservative"}'
```

riley-oncall: acknowledging customer impact. adding incident severity tag SEV-2 for now.

pagerduty-bot: PD-89234 acknowledged by riley-oncall at 4942008902.

noah-platform: one of the problematic nodes shows OOMKilled sidecar logs referencing `mount /etc/secret-volume: device busy` — looks like a race on CSI driver. Opening a ticket to infra: https://tickets.example/INF-331

jasmin-sre: mitigations in place: 1) split traffic to fallback 30% 2) conservative batching 3) restarted failing pod (inference-sidecar-0) on node eu-west-az-b.

riley-oncall: restarted succeeded, node now shows both containers running. p99 dropped from 2.1s -> 1.5s in the last 2m for the subset of traffic. overall p99 still ~1.8s because of in-flight requests and other problematic pods.

emma-product: are there any customers seeing errors (5xx) or just slow responses?

jasmin-sre: primarily latency, a handful (~0.1%) 504s as gateway timeouts for long requests. no broad error spike.

riley-oncall: next step: scale up pool for eu-west dedicated nodes by +2 to relieve pressure while infra triages CSI. noah-platform can you trigger the capacity increase?

noah-platform: triggering reserved-capacity scale: `cloudctl capacity set --pool eu-west-dedicated --add-nodes 2` — submitted. Estimated ready in ~70s.

deploy-bot: Autoscaler observed desired replicas increase -> 12 from 10; provisioning 2 nodes.

jasmin-sre: also applying temporary traffic shaping to long-tail customers: set `max_tokens_per_request=256` at the edge for non-enterprise routes to avoid very long sequences. Will revert after state stabilizes.

riley-oncall: applied policy via feature-flag.

pagerduty-bot: PD-89234 status: acknowledged · responders: riley-oncall, jasmin-sre, noah-platform.

sre-lead: quick check — please capture the timeline + actions in incident doc and tag for postmortem. assign jasmin-sre as lead for RCA.

riley-oncall: noted. creating incident doc: https://confluence.example/incidents/PD-89234-draft — adding timestamps and mitigations.

noah-platform: new nodes came up, pods scheduled fine; p99 now 1.3s for eu-west overall. SLO burn falling — 8% in last 5m.

jasmin-sre: removing the 30% split now to start gradual roll-forward of v3.4.1 after we confirm nodes stable. riley, confirm?

riley-oncall: hold — let's keep 20% on fallback for 10m to ensure stability, then 0% if no regressions.

emma-product: communications: posting an update to status page noting degraded latency in EU and that mitigations are in progress.

riley-oncall: agreed plan. handing off to night on-call at 4942012000 — @jasmin-sre will be primary during the stabilization window. I’ll leave the thread and handoff notes in the incident doc.

jasmin-sre: ack handoff. will monitor for next 45m. tagging infra and platform teams on the CSI driver ticket.

incident-bot: Incident PD-89234 — Hand-off: riley-oncall -> jasmin-sre at 4942012000. Current status: mitigated (p99 reduced, SLO burn decreasing).

riley-oncall: final note — root cause candidate: CSI driver race during recent config rollout + v3.4.1 memory profile exposing sidecar mount order. RCA ticket created and assigned.

sre-lead: postmortem requested. thanks team. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: PD-89234 incident status set to monitoring.
